  # Preserve the original suite failure. This is evidence collection only.
  if [ "$original_status" -ne 0 ] && [ -n "$ACTIVE_DEVICE" ] &&
      [ -n "${KIND:-}" ] && [ -f "$OUT/$KIND-binary.sha256" ]; then
    local diagnostic_main_sha diagnostic_binary_path diagnostic_device_type diagnostic_device_label
    if [ "$ACTIVE_DEVICE" = "$IPAD_UDID" ]; then
      diagnostic_device_type="$IPAD_TYPE"
      diagnostic_device_label=ipad
    else
      diagnostic_device_type="$IPHONE_TYPE"
      diagnostic_device_label=iphone
    fi
    read -r diagnostic_main_sha diagnostic_binary_path < "$OUT/$KIND-binary.sha256"
    stage first-failed-ios-bootstrap-diagnostic 660 "$OUT/spawn-diagnostic-supervisor.log" \
      python3 "${BIL_IOS_SPAWN_DIAGNOSTIC_HELPER:-.github/scripts/bil_ios_simulator_spawn_diagnostic.py}" \
      --qa-simulator-only --retain-exact-bundle \
      --workspace "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --app "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/ios/iphonesimulator/Runner.app" \
      --output "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$OUT/first-failed-bootstrap-diagnostic" \
      --source-head "$SOURCE_HEAD" --expected-main-sha256 "$diagnostic_main_sha" \
      --device "$ACTIVE_DEVICE" --runtime "$RUNTIME" --device-type "$diagnostic_device_type" \
      --device-label "$diagnostic_device_label" --entrypoint-kind "$KIND"
  fi
